title: A signal for milk production
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Prolactin promotes milk production. Oxytocin has a different role in milk ejection.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which anterior-pituitary hormone promotes milk production in mammary tissue? Prolactin promotes milk production. Oxytocin has a different role in milk ejection.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.
Recall: In the stated example, which source releases Prolactin into the circulation? Prolactin promotes milk production. Oxytocin has a different role in milk ejection.

recall.question: In the stated example, which source releases Prolactin into the circulation?
recall.why: Prolactin promotes milk production. Oxytocin has a different role in milk ejection.
